texts.zh:
[this.GetName]上的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]们观察到重力风暴对当地野生鸟类带来了严重的影响。

风暴带来的重力波动导致了异常的大气条件，让许多鸟类物种无法飞行。
texts.en:
The [Owner.GetScientistPlural] on [this.GetName] have observed harsh repercussions of the Gravity Storm on the local avian wildlife.

The gravitational fluctuations brought on by the storm are leading to erratic atmospheric conditions, rendering several species of avian fauna incapable of flight.

texts.zh: 真正的盛宴等待着我们。

这不仅使它们无法正常捕猎，也更容易受到捕食者攻击。

有人担心，如果我们不加以干预，这些受影响的物种可能会被赶尽杀绝。
texts.en:
Not only is this preventing the creatures unable to hunt as normal, it is also leaving them vulnerable to predators.

There is concern that the afflicted species may be hunted to extinction if we do not intervene.

label.zh: 把这些生物放入保护区。
label.en: Place the creatures in a reserve.

label.zh: 救下鸟类（花费350矿物）后，引力风暴再次离开
label.en: Birds saved (350 minerals): a gravity storm leaves again

label.zh: 在事态结束之前保存它们的基因物质。
label.en: Save their DNA before the end.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this planet appears here.

texts.zh:
紧接着重力风暴过境之后，[this.GetName]上暂时无法飞行的在我们的鸟类保护区内避难，又一次翱翔天空。

虽然许多动物现在已经回到了它们以前的栖息地，但仍有相当数量的动物留在保护区，似乎在享受保护区提供的舒适和保护。

这为近距离研究这颗星球上的野生鸟类提供了一个独特的机会。
texts.en:
Following the passing of the Gravity Storm, the temporarily flightless fauna of [this.GetName] have taken to the skies again having taken shelter inside our avian reserve.

While many of the creatures have now returned to their former habitats, significant numbers remain in the reserve, seemingly enjoying the comforts and protections it provides.

This presents a unique opportunity to study the planet's avian wildlife at close proximity.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this planet appears here.

summary.text:
# 不飞之羽 / Flightless Fauna

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: events/cosmic_storms_events_1.txt:3591-3797; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:5438,5412 · DLC: Cosmic Storms · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

引力风暴进入拥有殖民地的星系时（on_storm_entered_system，00_on_actions.txt:5413），cstorms.1770 选中一个星球，90天后 cstorms.1771“不飞之羽”（每国一次，需星系仍在引力风暴中）。

When a gravity storm enters a system with a colony (on_storm_entered_system, 00_on_actions.txt:5413) cstorms.1770 picks a planet and, 90 days later, cstorms.1771 "Flightless Fauna" appears (once per country, the system must still be in a gravity storm).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

四个互斥选项取决于帝国：蜂群吞噬者（a）获得食物，演化捕食者起源再得进度；其他帝国（b）获得社会研究，或（c，需350矿物且非演化捕食者）救下这些鸟类并获得团结；演化捕食者起源（evopred）得到DNA进度。选c之后，下一次引力风暴离开该星系时 cstorms.1775 在360天后弹出 cstorms.1776“再次飞翔”，星球获得 d_avian_reserve 矿点。

Four exclusive options depending on the empire: Devouring Swarm hives (a) gain food (Evolutionary Predators also DNA progress); other empires (b) gain society research or (c, 350 minerals, not Evolutionary Predators) save the birds and gain unity; Evolutionary Predators (evopred) get DNA progress. After option c the next gravity storm leaving the system leads, 360 days later, to cstorms.1776 "Airborne Again", and the planet gets the d_avian_reserve deposit.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

只有选项c会引出后续 cstorms.1776。

Only option c leads on to cstorms.1776.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

Cosmic Storms DLC；蜂群吞噬者与演化捕食者有专属选项。

Cosmic Storms DLC; Devouring Swarm and Evolutionary Predators have their own options.
